name: Michelle
source:
The Angel who Fell from Grace 

Michelle is the last person you expected to find in such a rough world, which is exactly why she needs you. She is a fan favorite, but her pretty face will only get her so far. She turns to you as someone she can count on.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/GeniusBishoujo/status/1521112575777333248?s=20&t=7sljkuwCRMbHa_q_aEPXMQ]official Twitter[/url]]
